promptsFromPreviousRevision.stage: Initial foreground; rejected due to rough transparency edges
promptsFromPreviousRevision.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: original foreground artwork for Memoria, a native macOS performance monitor; to be placed over an Icon Composer background.
Design one elegant brain emblem, viewed straight on. Two balanced rounded cerebral hemispheres, a clear narrow vertical separation, and only two broad flowing folds in each hemisphere. The silhouette must read unmistakably as a brain, not a cloud, heart or tree. Suggest memory and calm technical precision through the shape itself.
Use bold, beautifully drawn, smooth white paths with rounded ends and generous transparent negative spaces. Very simple vector-like flat white artwork; uniform solid white, no gradients or lighting in this foreground layer. The two hemispheres form one cohesive compact, slightly wider-than-tall symbol. No text, letters, eyes, face, circuits, nodes, chip pins, stems, anatomical realism or tiny detail.
Single isolated symbol on a genuinely transparent RGBA canvas, not a checkerboard. Square 1024 by 1024 composition. Centre the complete brain within about 680 by 650 pixels, leaving generous equal safety margins. All silhouette edges must be smooth and crisp and folds must remain readable when the whole canvas is reduced to 32 pixels.
Do not add an app icon tile, rounded-square background, outline around the canvas, cast shadow, baked glass, bevel, texture, border, watermark, mockup or presentation sheet. This is the reusable flat white foreground layer only.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the edit target: the original Memoria brain emblem.
Keep the same paired hemispheres, overall brain silhouette, generous square-canvas margins and two rounded flowing negative-space folds in each half.
Replace ALL of the rough white artwork with a perfectly smooth, clean, flat, solid deep cobalt blue emblem (#365BE8). Every visible part of the emblem must be opaque cobalt. Carefully eliminate ALL white/grey residues, fine outlines, dust, flecks, grain, mottling, ragged edges and accidental bridges across the transparent grooves. The central vertical separation and all four curved folds must be broad, uninterrupted, genuinely transparent, with smooth rounded ends. Use strong geometry as if this were exported from a professionally constructed vector logo.
Square composition, approximately 70% canvas width, centred. No texture, shadows, gradients, bevels, lighting or translucent colour within the blue mark. No background tile, no canvas border, no text. True transparent background around and within the emblem. The result should be a precise production logo layer that remains clear at small icon sizes.

Use case: logo-brand. Input image 1 is the exact Memoria brain logo to preserve.
Create the finished DEFAULT / LIGHT appearance of a refined macOS app icon using this emblem.
Keep the emblem's silhouette and all four broad negative-space folds exactly recognisable. Preserve its centred position, approximately 70 percent of the square canvas width, and generous equal margins. Render the brain as rich cobalt and periwinkle blue, with restrained, beautifully smooth tonal depth: a slightly lighter upper surface, a deep indigo lower edge, and soft tiny highlights. It should feel like a precisely sculpted satin-glass object, not a toy or a complicated 3D render. Keep every curve broad and legible.
The background is an opaque full-bleed square, a very subtle porcelain-white to pale ice-blue gradient (#F4F7FF to #DFE9FC). Keep clear contrast with the blue brain. Very soft close contact shading may sit immediately under the brain, not a large cast shadow. No grain, flecks, messy edges, white artifacts, tiny details or glow.
Output the app artwork alone, square, straight on. NO rounded outside corners: leave the square canvas unmasked for later platform export. NO outer drop shadow, extra frame, border, perspective, words, letters, labels, screenshots or presentation mockup. All outside edges are filled by the pale background. This is the production default appearance, not a contact sheet.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the edit target: Memoria's finished light app icon.
Create its DARK appearance by changing only the palette and surface lighting. Preserve the exact brain geometry, grooves, central separation, size, orientation and placement, and the square full-bleed layout.
Change the pale background to a rich near-black midnight navy (#10172C), with only a very restrained midnight-blue gradient. Change the brain to luminous but solid periwinkle and ice-blue (#89B8FF to #6785ED), keeping gentle satin-glass depth and soft upper highlights. It must have strong contrast on the dark background without glowing, neon bloom or bright outlines. Preserve all negative-space folds as dark background. Keep the mark calm, precise and premium.
No added details, no texture, no grain, no shadows outside the canvas, no text, no borders, no mockup. No rounded outside corners: the square image remains unmasked. This is a matching production dark version of the exact same icon, not a new logo.

designInstructions: Replace the abstract mark with a recognisable frontal brain, scalloped hemispheres, broad cortical folds, central fissure and a small stem. Flat cobalt foreground on transparent canvas.
Preserve the brain geometry for a porcelain and cobalt light app icon on an opaque square unmasked canvas with restrained shallow relief.
Create a matching dark appearance: midnight navy background and ice-blue brain; retain geometry, scale, folds and placement.
Derive a separate black alpha menu glyph with a simpler fold pattern and wider channels for small sizes.
Clean up the transparent foreground, preserving the brain anatomy while widening and clearing its central fissure and smoothing the cortical channels.
